source_family: One agent-authored fictional fermentation record family, exposed development controls; no plant source or human study.
source_truth: Typed source-row identities/locators and independent arithmetic only. No actual feed truth, assay validity, recipe optimum, causation, yield, kinetics or approval established.
control_requirements: Positive: explicit site/asset/batch/window/event/recipe/lab/outcome matches admit reported arithmetic, not a causal or installed-state conclusion.
Availability: as_of before B-lab availability makes its metric unavailable; future value must be absent from decision comparison while originals remain in a separately labelled audit/capture.
Retain every admitted CSV field, logical record locator, original raw byte/hash/size and operator manifest; no silent extra-column or duplicate-ID collapse.
Missing/ambiguous/foreign identity, UTC, phase, event boundary, recipe, scale, method, quantity/unit, quality or coverage cannot produce a complete comparison.
Null quality policy or incomplete integration cannot become complete feed mass; retain original reported material separately.
Different recipe/scale/assay method/outcome basis requires review; no silent normalization or latest-result selection.
Explicit upstream report/CSV/plan/optionalgraph and method pins checked before reusing feed metrics. Changed CSV with unchanged saved report must block affected metrics.

Saved joined report check uses only the newly selected operator manifest, compares all direct/transitive input and code pins, and reproduces whole typed result; forged output with matching pins fails.
Revision rebuild creates a new directory; earlier result and original records remain exact. No physical-source watcher, automatic accepted-answer selection, shared writer or company authority.
Invalid contracts, nonfinite data, oversized inputs or existing destination refuse without source overwrite or partial claimed success.
